summary: The university will hold Disability Awareness Week 2026 from Tuesday 3 November to Friday 6 November 2026, run together with the 2026 Health Week events. All members of the university are encouraged to take an interest and participate; participation is voluntary. The notice does not state event locations, times or how to take part.
applies_to: All members of the university community are invited; participation is encouraged, not mandatory.

dates.what: Disability Awareness Week 2026 operating period (held together with the 2026 Health Week events)

translation:
[Promotion] Announcement on the Operation of Disability Awareness Week 2026

To promote understanding of disability and improve awareness of it among members of our university, and to create an inclusive campus environment, Disability Awareness Week 2026 will be held as follows. We look forward to your interest and participation.

A. Organisers: Disability Student Support Center, Scholarship and Welfare Division, Adapted Physical Education Laboratory, and Sonmal Sarang (sign language club)

B. Theme: "Moving Hearts, Moving Together"
※ This means that, by everyone taking part in sports activities together regardless of whether they have a disability, we improve physical and mental health and build an inclusive campus where we understand and respect one another.

C. Operating period: Tuesday 3 November 2026 to Friday 6 November 2026
※ Operated in conjunction with the 2026 Health Week events.
